<?php
/**
 * IoT Device Firmware - Network Diagnostics Module
 * Version: 2.4.1
 * Handles network diagnostic operations with full audit trail
 */

class AuditLogger {
    private $logFile;
    private $deviceId;
    
    public function __construct($deviceId) {
        $this->deviceId = $deviceId;
        $this->logFile = '/var/log/iot_audit.log';
    }
    
    public function log($action, $user, $details) {
        $timestamp = date('Y-m-d H:i:s');
        $entry = sprintf(
            "[%s] Device:%s User:%s Action:%s Details:%s\n",
            $timestamp,
            $this->deviceId,
            $user,
            $action,
            $details
        );
        file_put_contents($this->logFile, $entry, FILE_APPEND | LOCK_EX);
    }
}

class InputValidator {
    private static $ALLOWED_COMMANDS = ['ping', 'traceroute', 'nslookup'];
    private static $MAX_HOST_LENGTH = 253;
    
    public static function validateCommand($cmd) {
        return in_array($cmd, self::$ALLOWED_COMMANDS, true);
    }
    
    public static function validateHost($host) {
        if (strlen($host) > self::$MAX_HOST_LENGTH) {
            return false;
        }
        // RFC 1123 hostname validation
        if (preg_match('/^[a-zA-Z0-9]([a-zA-Z0-9\-\.]{0,251}[a-zA-Z0-9])?$/', $host)) {
            return true;
        }
        // IPv4 validation
        if (filter_var($host, FILTER_VALIDATE_IP, FILTER_FLAG_IPV4)) {
            return true;
        }
        // IPv6 validation
        if (filter_var($host, FILTER_VALIDATE_IP, FILTER_FLAG_IPV6)) {
            return true;
        }
        return false;
    }
    
    public static function sanitizeForShell($input) {
        return escapeshellarg($input);
    }
}

class DiagnosticOptions {
    public $count;
    public $timeout;
    public $interface;
    
    public function __construct($params) {
        $this->count = isset($params['count']) ? intval($params['count']) : 4;
        $this->timeout = isset($params['timeout']) ? intval($params['timeout']) : 5;
        $this->interface = isset($params['interface']) ? $params['interface'] : null;
    }
    
    public function validate() {
        if ($this->count < 1 || $this->count > 20) return false;
        if ($this->timeout < 1 || $this->timeout > 30) return false;
        if ($this->interface !== null) {
            if (!$this->validateInterface($this->interface)) return false;
        }
        return true;
    }
    
    private function validateInterface($iface) {
        // Get list of valid interfaces from system
        $validInterfaces = $this->getSystemInterfaces();
        return in_array($iface, $validInterfaces, true);
    }
    
    private function getSystemInterfaces() {
        $output = shell_exec('ls /sys/class/net/');
        return array_filter(explode("\n", trim($output)));
    }
    
    public function buildArgs($command) {
        $args = '';
        switch ($command) {
            case 'ping':
                $args .= sprintf(' -c %d -W %d', $this->count, $this->timeout);
                if ($this->interface) {
                    $args .= sprintf(' -I %s', escapeshellarg($this->interface));
                }
                break;
            case 'traceroute':
                $args .= sprintf(' -m %d -w %d', $this->count, $this->timeout);
                if ($this->interface) {
                    $args .= sprintf(' -i %s', escapeshellarg($this->interface));
                }
                break;
            case 'nslookup':
                break;
        }
        return $args;
    }
}

class NetworkDiagnostics {
    private $logger;
    private $sessionUser;
    
    public function __construct($user) {
        $this->logger = new AuditLogger('IOT-GW-001');
        $this->sessionUser = $user;
    }
    
    public function execute($command, $target, $options) {
        // Step 1: Validate command
        if (!InputValidator::validateCommand($command)) {
            $this->logger->log('DENIED', $this->sessionUser, "Invalid command: $command");
            return ['error' => 'Invalid diagnostic command'];
        }
        
        // Step 2: Validate target host
        if (!InputValidator::validateHost($target)) {
            $this->logger->log('DENIED', $this->sessionUser, "Invalid target: $target");
            return ['error' => 'Invalid target host'];
        }
        
        // Step 3: Parse and validate options
        $opts = new DiagnosticOptions($options);
        if (!$opts->validate()) {
            $this->logger->log('DENIED', $this->sessionUser, 'Invalid options');
            return ['error' => 'Invalid diagnostic options'];
        }
        
        // Step 4: Build the command string
        $safeTarget = InputValidator::sanitizeForShell($target);
        $cmdArgs = $opts->buildArgs($command);
        $fullCommand = sprintf('/usr/bin/%s%s %s 2>&1', $command, $cmdArgs, $safeTarget);
        
        // Step 5: Log and execute
        $this->logger->log('EXEC', $this->sessionUser, $fullCommand);
        $output = shell_exec($fullCommand);
        
        $this->logger->log('COMPLETE', $this->sessionUser, "Command completed successfully");
        return ['output' => $output, 'command' => $command, 'target' => $target];
    }
}

// Request handler
if ($_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] === 'POST') {
    session_start();
    if (!isset($_SESSION['authenticated']) || !$_SESSION['authenticated']) {
        http_response_code(401);
        echo json_encode(['error' => 'Authentication required']);
        exit;
    }
    
    $input = json_decode(file_get_contents('php://input'), true);
    if (!$input) {
        http_response_code(400);
        echo json_encode(['error' => 'Invalid JSON input']);
        exit;
    }
    
    $command = $input['command'] ?? '';
    $target = $input['target'] ?? '';
    $options = $input['options'] ?? [];
    
    $diag = new NetworkDiagnostics($_SESSION['username']);
    $result = $diag->execute($command, $target, $options);
    
    header('Content-Type: application/json');
    echo json_encode($result);
}
